ownFinal.note: One additive cold agent-runtime replacement control after66-run; runtime diff is empty.

contractsPreserved: Only existing current owner can appoint an existing active member; current/previous owner metadata and original grant semantics are protected and persisted by the existing shared reducer.
An outgoing agent owner loses manage_members/decide; outgoing human permission snapshot remains under the established contract.
Fresh authentication precedes lost-response duplicate recognition, so revocation wins even on retry.
Owner delegate and membership delegation added_invite_member=0 grants lapse on transfer; an invite bit held independently before delegation is retained.
No work/history hydration and no changes to existing work bodies when ownership changes. Project tables remain keyed by room identity, not host process or bearer credential.

Deletion inventory reads protected room/head and selected account-member candidates; complete <=100 member-key census and early active-other selection preserve succession classification without unrelated profile bodies. The existing eligible-human/account/login policy and deterministic heir sorting remain unchanged.
Unavailable or corrupt protected inventory is an explicit error, never an empty owned-room list; genuine missing legacy404 remains skippable.
Same-principal replacement runtime uses authorized credential rotation, old credential401, exact accepted work unchanged across cold restart and subsequent work.started by the stable member.
remainingLimits: Active membership delegation added_invite_member=1 requires a permission-strip subevent path still unported for current format. Transfer preflights and refuses atomically with current_room_context_unavailable; no silent bit carryover. Synthetic old-state dependency control qualifies refusal, not a real added1 migration.

Account deletion execution/archive/membership deactivation is not ported to current format. The original misleading preview is fixed; deletion execution remains fail closed, not qualified end-to-end. Initial read-only reproduction demonstrated accounts/member bindings roll back when the unported body path refuses.

Different-principal replacement cannot impersonate the accountable agent or designated decision-maker. Work IDs/results survive but explicit role IDs are not rewritten by owner transfer. Existing legacy work.superseded two-work replacement path remains unported to normalized commands.

Existing personal-room deletion policy archives/purges sole-owned personal rooms with no eligible human heir, even with other members. AgentRooms.create defaults personal. Organization projects block until succession. This product policy was not silently changed under a narrow continuity fix.
No automatic replacement owner when the sole owner is unreachable. Existing owner-only authorization remains; any new fallback authority needs an explicit product decision and grant.

Inventory keeps per-read256KiB and internal1024 logical-unit admission; very large legal candidate human profiles may explicitly refuse rather than omit a project. No new index/auth domain/cache or global cap increase.

ActualWorker inventory cost grows only with bounded member-key census (347→443 rows for4→100); transfer5612rows includes unchanged catalog/delegation-journal verification overhead and is not claimed optimal or constant in global delegation history.
ActualWorker constructor startup excluded from cold request counters; adapter counters plus raw runtime permit flips are recorded separately, not a claim to observe every native maintenance write.
No production publish/deploy/live verification, no external credential/resource access transferred or broadened.
